seo.title: About Us — uPVC Manufacturer in Kathmandu
seo.description: Hi-Tech uPVC Profile Industries is a Kathmandu-based manufacturer of uPVC windows, doors, and panels. From our Tarakeshwar factory, Lambagar glass unit, and Tokha workshop, we design, fabricate, and install across Nepal.

hero.title: Made in Kathmandu, for the way Nepal lives.
hero.body: Hi-Tech uPVC Profile Industries designs, fabricates, and installs uPVC windows, doors, and panels from our own sites in the Kathmandu valley — built for valley dust, monsoon rain, and cold winter mornings.
hero.imageAlt: Modern home at dusk with large dark-framed glazed doors and windows glowing with warm interior light
hero.imageCaption: Large-format glazing, slim dark frames — the kind of openings we build.

story.title: A local workshop with a factory standard.
paragraphs: Hi-Tech began with a simple observation: homes in Kathmandu were still fitted with frames that swelled in the monsoon, let in dust, and needed painting every few years. Families deserved windows that simply worked.

Today we run our own factory at Bihani Chowk, Tarakeshwar, a glass processing unit at Lambagar, and a fabrication workshop in Tokha. Keeping profiles, glass, and fitting under one roof lets us control quality at every step — and answer for it.
Every frame is cut to the millimetre for its opening, assembled by our own team, and installed by fitters who live and work in the valley.

services.title: From the first measurement to the last handle.

items.title: uPVC windows
items.body: Sliding, casement, and tilt & turn windows with multi-chamber profiles and double glazing for quieter, warmer rooms.

items.title: uPVC doors
items.body: Sliding patio, French, folding, and entrance doors with multi-point locking and weather-tight gaskets.

items.title: Panels & partitions
items.body: uPVC panels for partitions, cladding, and interiors — moisture-proof, termite-proof, and easy to clean.

items.title: Glass processing
items.body: Toughened, laminated, and double-glazed units prepared at our Lambagar glass unit for safety and insulation.

items.title: Site measurement & installation
items.body: Our team measures on site, fabricates to size, and installs with clean finishing — homes, apartments, and commercial projects.

items.title: Aftercare & warranty
items.body: Adjustments, hardware servicing, and warranty support long after handover. One call or WhatsApp message away.

sites.title: Three sites across the Kathmandu valley.
sites.body: Visit any of our sites to see profiles, glass, and finished units in person.

roles.label: Head Office & Factory
roles.description: Our main factory and office, where uPVC profiles are processed and frames are cut, welded, and assembled.

roles.label: Hitech Glass
roles.description: Our glass unit in Kathmandu, preparing toughened and double-glazed units for every window and door.

roles.label: Hi-Tech UPVC Windows
roles.description: Fabrication workshop and display space in Tokha — see finished windows and doors and discuss your project.

values.title: Principles we build by.
values.body: Good uPVC windows and doors are only as good as the decisions behind them. These four principles guide every project we take on in the Kathmandu valley — from a single bedroom window to a full commercial facade.

highlight.title: One team, factory to fitting.
highlight.body: Profiles, glass, fabrication, and installation stay with Hi-Tech — so there is always one number to call.

items.title: Built for Nepal
items.body: Profiles, gaskets, and glass are chosen for Kathmandu conditions — fine valley dust, heavy monsoon rain, strong UV, and cold winter mornings.

items.title: Made to measure
items.body: We measure every opening on site and fabricate each window and door to size, so frames sit square in local brick and concrete walls.

items.title: Honest advice
items.body: We recommend the opening type, glazing, and hardware your room actually needs — and give a clear, itemised quote before any work begins.

items.title: We stay accountable
items.body: Our own factory, our own fitters, and our own aftercare team. If something needs adjusting after handover, we come back and fix it.

serviceAreas.title: Serving Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur — and beyond.
serviceAreas.body: We install throughout the Kathmandu valley and deliver to projects across Nepal.

regions.label: Kathmandu valley
regions.body: Measured, fabricated, and installed by our own team — with aftercare a short drive away.

regions.label: Across Nepal
regions.body: Factory-fabricated units shipped to projects outside the valley, with installation arranged on request.
